Our outbound pipeline engine, Halyard, surfaces buying signals, finds the right contacts, and drafts researched, cited first‑touch emails, letting growth teams build pipeline without extra SDR headcount.
Would you be open to a brief 15‑minute call to explore how this could support your AI recommendation rollout?
